formula: Classify each surviving P135 lead as (1) interval reduction, (2) candidate-set reduction, or (3) ranking-only=0 bits; b_removed=134-log2(M) or 134-log2(W); no additive intersection without measure
domains: all ledger P135 claims vs S-03 verified-bit gate
score_definition: verified bits removed under locked promotion requirements
expected_direction: most historical leads score 0; only proven exclusions credit bits

allowed_parameters.intersection: measure |A cap B|; do not sum b_A+b_B
allowed_parameters.risky_heuristic: partial retention without 100% holdout = 0 verified bits

holdout_split: 100% holdout coverage required for any credited cut
trivial_exclusion_justification: Audit of claimed reductions; DL recompute is not a lead.
